name: wikiqa
description: WikiQA is an answer-selection / question-answering benchmark where systems must choose or rank candidate sentences from Wikipedia that correctly answer a given question. It measures retrieval/ranking quality and answer correctness rather than free-form generation. Primarily used to evaluate QA ranking and sentence-level answer selection models.
reputation: Well-known, classical QA/answer-selection dataset widely used in information retrieval and QA research as a standard benchmark.
